blocking.issue: Regression: the revision deleted OQ-system-overview-5 (which match criteria run before onRequestHeaders) but left the question unanswered. The Fixed Route invariant says the header match fixes the Route before any Phase runs. The owning Configuration model defines a body-dependent Route match criterion, `match.graphql` (operationType, operationName), which a POST GraphQL request carries only in its body. A contributor building the Router cannot satisfy both documents: onRequestHeaders cannot run 'after the header match fixes the Route' for a GraphQL Route unless the body is read first. Nothing here describes a pre-chain body read, and it would conflict with 'Bodies stream unless a body Phase is subscribed'.
blocking.evidence: 01 line 238: "**Fixed Route.** The header match fixes the Route; body-dependent criteria choose only among its Upstream legs or `AIModel` candidates. If re-match is ever allowed, the new Route's chain MUST run from `onRequestHeaders`." 01 line 176: "| `onRequestHeaders` | Once, after the header match fixes the Route |". 02 line 274: "graphql: {operationType: query, operationName: GetOrder}" under `Route.spec.match`; 02 line 302: "`grpc` and `graphql` matching are `Planned (M3)`"; 02 line 679: "`Route.spec.match.when` | bool | Route matching | `request` (no body)". The previous draft (docs/_meta/drafts/system-overview.draft3.md line 420) had "OQ-system-overview-5 | Which match criteria are evaluated before `onRequestHeaders` and which are refined in `onRoute`?"; it is gone from the current Open questions table.

Restore the row: "OQ-system-overview-5 | How does `match.graphql` select a Route before `onRequestHeaders`? | Bounded pre-match body read for GraphQL listeners; query string, header or persisted-query ID only; move operation matching to an `onRoute` leg selector | multi-protocol | Yes, for Data plane and Multi-protocol".

blocking.issue: The only non-Git path into Ruralz Control is misdescribed, and the description contradicts the owning Configuration model. This document says `ruralz bundle push` hands a Revision to Ruralz Control. 02 says Ruralz Control never accepts a pre-rendered Revision: the CLI uploads the source Bundle plus its expected digest, and Control re-renders and rejects a mismatch. An architect designing the push API (04) or its trust model (08) would build the wrong thing from this sentence. This document never states the correct flow anywhere else; Figure 4 covers only the Git path.
blocking.evidence: 01 line 93: "Only Ruralz Control reads Git; `ruralz bundle push` can also hand a Revision to Ruralz Control or an OCI registry, from which file-mode Nodes pull Revisions and Plugin artifacts by digest." 02 line 762: "Ruralz Control never accepts a pre-rendered Revision: `ruralz bundle push --env prod` to Ruralz Control uploads the source Bundle with the digest the CLI computed; Ruralz Control re-renders it with the Environment's own variables, rejects a mismatch with RZ-CFG-027 ... Pushing to an OCI registry uploads the rendered Revision for file-mode Nodes."
blocking.fix: Rewrite as: "Only Ruralz Control reads Git. `ruralz bundle push` uploads a source Bundle and its expected digest to Ruralz Control, which re-renders it and rejects a mismatch (`RZ-CFG-027`), or publishes a rendered Revision to an OCI registry, from which file-mode Nodes pull by digest." Label the Figure 1 edge `cli -.-> ctl` as "8090 REST API, source Bundle push".
